meta.title: Minecraft dev companion
meta.description: Launch the NetEase Minecraft ModPC dev client from DSH with the plugin's own launcher, follow the official game log, execute Python inside the game through an in-game bridge pack, search the bundled NetEase ModSDK docs, and assist mod development.

panel.title: Minecraft dev

panel.idleHint: The game is not running. Press “Launch game”, or run /mcdev discover to check the ModPC setup.
panel.notReadyHint: The game has not entered a save yet; logs and code execution may be limited.
